name: Premier Packaging Inc
old_description: Innovation in its modern meaning is “a new idea, creative thoughts, new imaginations in form of device or method”. Innovation is often also viewed as the application of better solutions that meet new requirements, unarticulated needs, or existing market needs.
about:
Premier Packaging Inc. was founded in 1986 in Charlotte, North Carolina, as a family-owned business. The company opened its doors serving the retail bag market and has remained in the same location for over three decades.

Today, Premier Packaging supplies a range of packaging products, including the FiberFlow and FiberForm lines, across the food and industrial packaging sectors. Beyond product supply, the company provides application engineering to help customers select the right size, material, or alternative solution. Its services include in-person and virtual sales support, sample provision after pricing approval, participation in plant trials to certify performance and optimize processes, and technical machine support backed by a specialist who spent 15 years as head engineer at a leading film machine manufacturer.

The company serves customers in food packaging and industrial packaging, offering tailored product recommendations and trial support for applications in those markets.

Premier Packaging emphasizes its long-term commitment to innovation, noting that its product line has continually evolved over 36 years. The availability of a dedicated machine specialist with deep OEM experience is presented as a key differentiator for technical support and trial optimization.
